name: Ahsoka Tano
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Crossed white lightsaber hilts mounted on a Fulcrum intelligence relay banner, etched with Anakin's old subspace frequency sigil
Togruta montrals framing a holoprojector displaying the Rebel Alliance starbird on a covert resistance standard
332nd Company pauldron mounted beside a white lightsaber blade fragment on a Siege of Mandalore battle pennant
vehicleSuggestions: Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor — Ahsoka's agile Clone Wars starfighter used in fast strike deployments
T-6 shuttle — covert transport Ahsoka used while operating as Fulcrum between rebel cells
LAAT/i gunship — 501st/332nd assault dropship from the Siege of Mandalore, ferrying commandos into hot zones

factionTrait.name: Marauders Champion
factionTrait.text: A marauder moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy follower.

uniqueTraits.name: Jar'Kai Defiance
uniqueTraits.text: After Ahsoka Tano gains 1 or more wounds from an enemy skill, she may gain {protection_boon} or {dodge_boon}.

ultimate.name: Fulcrum's Push
ultimate.text: Move Ahsoka Tano up to 2 hexes. Then move each other friendly model within range up to 2 hexes in the order of your choice.

plotSkills.name: Whirlwind Assault
plotSkills.text: This skill may target up to 3 models in 1 hex. After using Whirlwind Assault, move Ahsoka Tano up to 1 hex.

plotSkills.name: Aggressive Negotiations
plotSkills.text: Ahsoka Tano may use this skill as a bonus action.

plotSkills.name: Dual Saber Flurry
plotSkills.text: Choose up to 2 hexes within range that are adjacent to each other. This skill can target 1 model in each of those hexes.

clashSkills.name: Dual Saber Flurry
clashSkills.text: Choose up to 2 hexes within range that are adjacent to each other. This skill can target 1 model in each of those hexes.

traits.name: Suppressing Push
traits.text: At the end of the Rebel Commandos' activation, choose a hex adjacent to a Rebel Commando. You may move each enemy follower in that hex up to 1 hex.

plotSkills.name: Covert Insertion
plotSkills.text: One Rebel Commando may move up to 3 hexes.

plotSkills.name: Guerrilla Strike
plotSkills.text: After using Guerrilla Strike, each Rebel Commando in this hex may move up to 1 hex.
